faq.q: How is a titanium ball valve stem manufactured?
faq.a: A typical titanium ball valve stem is manufactured using Seamless tube extrusion; CNC machining; TIG welding (ERTi-2 filler); Hydrostatic testing. BOZE CNC Ti uses precision CNC equipment with strict process controls to ensure consistent quality and dimensional accuracy.

faq.q: What are the alternatives to Grade 2 CP-Ti for titanium ball valve stem?
faq.a: Alternative materials include stainless steel (heavier, susceptible to corrosion) and aluminum (lower strength, shorter fatigue life). The alternative manufacturing method is Laser welding (higher capital cost, limited wall thickness capability).

faq.q: What standards apply to titanium ball valve stem?
faq.a: Titanium Ball Valve Stem components are typically manufactured to ASTM B348, ASME. Additional customer-specific specifications may apply.

faq.q: What are common failure modes for titanium ball valve stem?
faq.a: Common failure modes include Crevice corrosion at seat interface in stagnant chemical service. BOZE CNC Ti mitigates these through strict process control, proper material selection, and 100% inspection.
